name: Mostak Mahmud Chowdhury
intro: I study how machines understand language, images, and the connections between them. At Samsung R&D Institute Bangladesh, I bring that curiosity to production software and applied AI.
bio: A Computer Science and Engineering graduate from CUET, I work across natural language processing, multimodal learning, and video understanding. My research spans four peer-reviewed publications and a thesis on temporally consistent video colorization. I am interested in academic teaching and research that connects rigorous foundations with practical engineering.
